# `candid match`

Score a job description against your profile.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid match [-h] [--jd JD] [--app-id APP_ID] [--company COMPANY] [--role ROLE] [--location LOCATION] [--json]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--jd` `JD` | JD text, file path, URL, or - to read the JD from stdin (e.g. `cat jd.txt | python -m candid match --jd -`) |
| `--app-id` `APP_ID` | Tracked job id — pulls company/role/JD from the tracker |
| `--company` `COMPANY` | Company name |
| `--role` `ROLE` | Role title |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | Location |
| `--json` | Print the raw match result as JSON (for scripting) |
